baseline.phone_evidence: User screenshot shows version 0.13 with 3 tabs, Google results and internal route ready; user requests link context actions and browser-like UI

features: Long-press HTTPS link context menu with actual href preview
Foreground new-tab opening preserves original DOM/search page
Lazy background tab queue loads only after selection; 8-tab limit retained
Explicit copy URL, copy bounded link text, share URL through Android chooser
Native ordinary-text selection preserved; short tap remains in current tab
Compact plus/tab-count/overflow toolbar and expandable connection details
System day/night palette retains native button geometry and spacing

upgrade_proof.signer_kind: disposable CI upgrade-test key; not the production release key
upgrade_proof.source_upgrade: tested 0.13 runtime source to new 0.14 source

limits: Not full Chrome/Opera/Tor Browser feature or protection parity
Automatic web popup windows remain disabled; new tab action is explicit context-menu choice
Background page is fetched only on selection
Context URLs limited to HTTPS; no executable/local/external schemes
Website cookies/session shared as before; no page HTML, draft or form body restored
IP scanner stays discovery only and does not become a browser gateway
next_test: Long-press Google result and open in new tab; check source tab remains
